scope: Six clean intact top-down 2D base props on genuine transparent backgrounds; no blood, rust or damaged variants; no scene/prefab/runtime changes.
scalePolicy: Suggested visible widths only, not final gameplay sizes. Depth derived from generated solid-alpha aspect ratio; originals never stretched. No PPU, collisions, shadows or surface audio wired yet.
knownLimitations: Base-color studies include mild local edge relief and contact shading; compatibility with moving in-game light has not been tested.
